Valve's Steam Frame has arrived, and Linus unboxes it with his daughter to see what wireless PC VR feels like without a tether. They go hands on with the 6GHz streaming dongle, the ergonomic accessories kit, the compute module and specs, then test fit, comfort and foveated streaming in Half-Life: Alyx and local co-op.
